fate.display: August 1942; deported with the children and staff of his Warsaw orphanage to their deaths at Treblinka.

fateClassificationNote: Death as a result of Nazi persecution; specific circumstances are described without inferring a direct execution.
biography: The physician and writer Janusz Korczak led a children's home in Warsaw. His documented name was Henryk Goldszmit.
uncertainty: USHMM places the deportation on 5 or 6 August and describes killing on arrival as almost certain. No exact death day is asserted; the birth year is also uncertain.
